purpose: Make execution observable enough to explain state transitions, repeated work, runtime cost, context loading, repair and delivery without exposing chain-of-thought.

per_node_telemetry.token_rule: exact provider/host usage when available; otherwise explicitly labeled estimate

execution_receipts.rule: A material transition is complete only when its persisted state transition and receipt agree.

context_accounting.rule: Filesystem scanning is not model-context consumption; platform overhead is not charged to playbook-controlled context.

pass_count_diagnostic.rule: Unexpected repeated execution is diagnostic evidence; investigate changed dependencies, recovery routing, state instability and regeneration before scoring.

hotspot_ranking.select: rank and surface highest actionable playbook-controlled hotspot; do not confuse platform overhead with playbook cost

standard_debug_bundle.rule: Each expected surface is present or the debug index records why it was unobservable/unavailable; never fabricate usage or reads.
